title: FIXME marker in a calculation comment
description: Unfinished-work rule — a FileMaker calculation carries a FIXME marker (FIXME, FIX ME, FIX IT, FIXIT) inside one of its comments. Five slots are scanned: custom-function bodies, field calculations, auto-enter and validation calculations, and script step calculations. The marker only counts inside a comment segment (// to end of line, or /* … */) — a string literal "FIX IT" in a Substitute() is not a finding.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A FIXME in a calculation comment marks a formula the author knew to be wrong. Calculations are the hardest place to notice such a note — they have no step list and no debugger breakpoint, so the marker is the only signal that the result is not trusted.
rule.remediation: Fix the formula and remove the marker, or move the note into a tracker issue and leave the comment pointing at it.

meta.name: FIXME marker in a calculation comment
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Unfinished-work rule — a FIXME marker inside a calculation comment. Detector canon of the family: (?i)\bfix[\s\-_]?(it|me)\b, verified by tools/tests/rules/unfinished_work_detector.sql, which also covers the comment-segment extraction. Code_Chunks offers no comment type (NoRef | VariableReference | FunctionRef | CustomFunctionRef | FieldRef), so the segments are extracted by regex; a // inside a string literal (a URL) is a known limit. Overlap with calc_comment_todo is intended.
